timeline.silence_accounting: Empty timeline leading/trailing both describe same whole interval; do not sum them. Otherwise categories are disjoint.

structure.meaning: Half-open2barblocks. Onset counts differ from sounding notes. Occupancy uses exact interval union clipped ONLY for measurement. Block intervals are signed consecutive minimum-pitch anchors, not melodyvoice; equality requires>=2groups, no alignment.3gram uses overlapping windows of3signed anchor intervals (4groups), repeated occurrences beyondfirst; windows notindependent.
